author: NorthEast News Desk
body: A new ramp carrying Route 1 north traffic to Route 37 west is scheduled to open Friday night in Warwick, changing the path for drivers traveling from T.F. Green International Airport toward Interstate 95.

The Rhode Island Department of Transportation said motorists will pass the existing looping ramp and turn left at a temporary traffic signal to enter Route 37 west. The old ramp will close at the same time so crews can continue demolishing the bridge that carries Route 37 over Post Road.

RIDOT urged drivers to slow down and use care while becoming familiar with the new intersection. The agency is rebuilding the interchange so traffic can enter and leave Route 37 through signalized junctions instead of the old ramp-and-bridge layout.

Once the permanent signals are installed, RIDOT plans to synchronize them along the corridor from the airport to Elmwood Avenue. The Friday-night shift is weather-dependent and construction schedules can change, but it represents a significant interim step for one of the state’s key airport-to-highway connections.
dek: Drivers leaving T.F. Green for I-95 will use a temporary signalized left turn as RIDOT closes the old looping ramp.
headline: New Route 1 north ramp to Route 37 west opens Friday night
